(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 hole (D12) is a tight-tolerance fit feature, but the drawing does not state whether the H7 limits apply before or after the zinc plating (surface_treatment: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)). Plating buildup will shrink the bore and can cause assembly interference; the designer must add a note specifying that the H7 tolerance applies after plating, or open the pre-plate size to allow for coating thickness."
  , "recommended_correction": "Add a note such as 'H7 TOLERANCE APPLIES AFTER PLATING' or specify an adjusted pre-plate diameter that accounts for the zinc coating thickness."}]}
